form.label: Contact form
form.description: Says thank you when the form is sent; with a real action (your form service's address) it sends there first

accordion.label: Accordion
accordion.description: A group of questions where one answer is open at a time

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: Buttons that each show one panel; arrow keys move between them

carousel.label: Carousel
carousel.description: Slides side by side, one at a time, with Previous and Next

reveal.label: Reveal
reveal.description: Fades a section in as it scrolls into view, unless the visitor asks for less motion

year.label: Current year
year.description: Writes the current year, for a footer's ©
